h1: EncuentraYa: Building a Production-Ready Search Platform
intro: EncuentraYa is a Uruguayan platform that connects people with local services and businesses. Urruty Labs partnered with the founding team to establish a solid technical foundation, accelerate product delivery, and prepare the platform for growth. Read all our

overview.outcomeValue: Production-ready platform with scalable architecture and initial user traction
overview.p1: EncuentraYa set out to solve a real problem: helping people in Uruguay quickly find and connect with local service providers. The founding team had a clear vision and early market validation, but needed senior engineering leadership to turn that vision into a reliable, scalable product.
overview.p2: Urruty Labs stepped in as the technical partner, owning architecture decisions, leading development, and ensuring every layer of the product was built to last — not just to ship.

challenge.p1: The team faced the classic early-stage dilemma: move fast enough to validate the market while building something that won't collapse under real usage. Previous attempts had resulted in fragile prototypes that couldn't support the search, filtering, and listing features the product required.
items: Designing a search and discovery experience that felt fast and relevant to end users
Building a scalable data model to support diverse service categories and provider profiles
Establishing a reliable deployment pipeline to enable continuous iteration
Ensuring the codebase was maintainable so the founding team could take ownership post-engagement

solution.p1: Urruty Labs led the end-to-end technical build, starting with architecture and working through to production deployment. We made deliberate technology choices optimized for the team's long-term ability to maintain and extend the product.
items: Designed a clean, normalized data model supporting flexible service categories and rich provider profiles
Implemented a performant search and filtering layer with relevance ranking tailored to local service discovery
Built a component-driven frontend with a focus on mobile usability and fast load times
Established CI/CD pipelines and environment parity to reduce deployment risk
Documented architecture decisions and onboarded the founding team to ensure continuity

results.p1: Within the engagement window, EncuentraYa went from fragile prototype to a production-ready platform capable of supporting real users and real providers.
items: Scalable architecture supporting multiple service verticals from day one
Founding team fully onboarded and able to iterate independently
Initial user and provider traction validated the core search and discovery experience
Clean, documented codebase ready for future feature development
results.p2: The engagement demonstrated what senior-led engineering looks like in practice: not just writing code, but making the right decisions at the right time so the product can grow.
